auditor_ernst: Hi team — for SOC 2 evidence pack we need: 1) formal retention window definition for API access logs and KMS usage logs; 2) a contiguous sample export of access/KMS logs covering 2025-11-01 to 2025-11-07 (no sampling if possible); 3) chain-of-custody manifest for that export and confirmation on HSM attestation artifacts. Can you confirm timeline and what we can attach to the packet?

maria_sre: Thanks, @auditor_ernst. We can produce a contiguous 7-day export and an accompanying manifest. Retention policy: API access logs (application + gateway) retained for 24 months; KMS usage logs (CloudTrail + HSM audit stream) retained for 36 months.

lee_security: To confirm HSM attestations — we maintain vendor-signed attestation PDFs and PDF hashes stored in S3. We can include the attestation for the HSMs used in the private deploy fleet (vendor: SafeVault HSM, cert date 2025-09-12).

export-bot: export-job 983402 queued by maria_sre for range 2025-11-01..2025-11-07. Estimated completion 45m. S3 destination: s3://redwood-exports/soc2/2025-11-01_2025-11-07/logs.zip

maria_sre: For auditor convenience: we'll provide both raw logs and a redacted set. Redaction rules: remove bearer tokens, IPs hashed with HMAC-SHA256, and user identifiers per policy. Manifest will include file hashes, job id, generated_by, generation_time, and KMS-signature (alias/redwood-soc2-manifest). Example manifest keys:

```json
{
  "job_id": "983402",
  "range": "2025-11-01T00:00:00Z/2025-11-08T00:00:00Z",
  "files": ["api-2025-11-01.log.gz","kms-cloudtrail-2025-11-01.json.gz"],
  "hash_algorithm": "sha256",
  "signature_key": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/alias/redwood-soc2-manifest"
}
```

tim_support: Repro steps for KMS events (if you want to re-run locally):

```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events 
  --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com 
  --start-time "2025-11-01T00:00:00Z" 
  --end-time "2025-11-08T00:00:00Z" 
  --output json > kms-events-2025-11-01_07.json

# then filter for GenerateDataKey/Encrypt/Decrypt events:
cat kms-events-2025-11-01_07.json | jq '.Events[] | select(.EventName | test("GenerateDataKey|Encrypt|Decrypt"))' > kms-key-ops.json
```

maria_sre: Note — our standard SOC2 evidence exports are not sampled by default. For routine internal summaries we use 1:20 sampling, but per audit requests we run unsampled contiguous exports.

lee_security: Chain-of-custody: manifest will include S3 path, sha256 of zip, KMS-signed manifest, and an audit log entry that records who initiated export (maria_sre) and the job id. We'll also include the internal ticket link and the pull request id for the redaction config used.

auditor_ernst: That looks good. Two quick clarifications: 1) can you include the KMS key usage summary (counts by key id) for the period? 2) confirm whether HSM attestation PDF includes firmware version and signature chain.

maria_sre: Yes to 1 — we'll attach a CSV with counts by key id (key_id, operation, count). Example row: `alias/redwood-app: Encrypt, 1245`. For 2 — vendor attestation includes firmware version and signature chain hash; we will include the PDF and the S3 object hash in the manifest.

export-bot: export-job 983402 status: completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-exports/soc2/2025-11-01_2025-11-07/logs.zip (sha256: 3b7a1f...c9d8), manifest: s3://redwood-exports/soc2/manifests/2025-11-01_2025-11-07-manifest.json (signed)

auditor_ernst: Perfect — can you upload the package to the secure auditor bucket and notify me (auditor-access@auditingco.com)? Need it by COB tomorrow. Thanks! :thumbsup:

maria_sre: Uploading now to s3://redwood-auditor-uploads/auditor_ernst/2025-11-01_07/ and sharing presigned link (48h). Will ping once link is live.

tim_support: If you want to locally validate the signature: `aws kms verify --key-id alias/redwood-soc2-manifest --message-type RAW --signature fileb://manifest.sig --message fileb://manifest.json`

auditor_ernst: Received presigned link, started download, will confirm after validation. Thanks all.
